coverage_basis: 23 existing regions.json records, separate from 193 sovereign countries
rules: Three original official government/business service links per territory where available; government offices are not counted as independent agencies by default.
Three distinct locally publishing newsrooms per territory; government press releases cannot count as news publishers.
For defence, mark responsible parent-state agency as parent_authority; do not assert a territory has its own military.
Empty arrays mean no verified candidate entered, never imply a link or live data feed.
Government/business, local news and environment/weather/emergency counts must remain separate from sovereign-country totals.
